name: David Taylor
bio: a Representative from Ohio; born in Ohio, November 16, 1969; graduated from Amelia High School, Amelia, Ohio; B.A., Miami University, Miami, Ohio, 1992, J.D., University of Dayton School of Law, Dayton, Ohio, 1996; assistant prosecutor, Clermont County, Ohio; business owner, elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
